function temporalCliArgs(query: TemporalQuery): string[] {
  return [
    "--temporal-view",
    query.view,
    "--request-time",
    query.request_time,
    ...(query.world_at === undefined ? [] : ["--world-at", query.world_at]),
    "--known-at",
    query.known_at,
    ...(query.transition === undefined
      ? []
      : ["--transition-from", query.transition.from, "--transition-to", query.transition.to]),
